name: Max Beckmann
findings: Within his own canvases, viridian turns up as a small accent in 60% of the paintings that hold it, 9.4x the archive's rate (from 642 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, grey purple turns up as the lightest note in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 4.1x the archive's rate (from 642 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, graphite violet turns up as the shadow in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 2.7x the archive's rate (from 642 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 642 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 642 paintings here).
Pairs green brown with greenish yellow more than chance would predict (3 of 642 paintings here).
Pairs azure blue with espresso more than chance would predict (3 of 642 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (black, black blue, raisin black) covers 60% of his paintings here.
